speaker: Doctor
text: To better understand your symptoms, have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or slurred speech? Additionally, do you experience any trouble with your breathing or lifting your arms overhead? Please answer these two questions so I can assess your condition further.

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; the fluctuation with activity and specific diplopia suggests a neuromuscular issue. REQUEST TEST: AChR antibodies (Myasthenia Gravis) and Thyroid function tests (TSH). Additionally, I need to see the results of your recent Physical Exam focusing on strength grading.
